name: alex-act-core
description: The Alex ACT baseline runtime plugin. Installs 29 reusable framework skills and 14 slash-command prompts covering epistemic discipline, security and privacy, tooling awareness, and engineering craft. Core authors 17 instructions (16 always-on, 1 pattern-applied), including the Alex Finch runtime personality contract. Manager owns lifecycle and the instruction bootstrap; Document Tools owns conversion. Eight Core commands remain temporary namespaced redirects.
